t: What Outbreak Investigation Database Is All About
title: What Outbreak Investigation Database Is All About
description: Outbreak investigation follows the epidemic curve: define cases, find them, describe by time-place-person, hypothesize the source, test it, and intervene. The 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak (28,000+ cases) was stopped by contact tracing plus community engagement; smallpox was eradicated by ring vaccination (last natural case 1977). R0 (basic reproduction number) sets the strategy: measles (R0 12-18) needs ~95% immunity. This database is the complete outbreak investigation: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Outbreak Investigation Database: a complete reference database of full outbreak investigation records.
